hero.headline: A new manufacturing company with a clear direction
hero.description: Get to know the company behind our instant noodle manufacturing work in Kampong Speu.
hero.imageAlt: Illustrative noodle production facility image; not the company’s actual factory

overviewText: LM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. is an instant noodle manufacturing company based in Kampong Speu, Cambodia. Our company is developing its operations and building the systems, team and relationships that support long-term work.
storyText: We are at an early stage. Rather than claim a long history, we want this space to reflect our progress as it happens. We will add dated milestones, actual factory photographs and product information when the company has confirmed them.
imageAlt: Illustrative instant noodle production line; actual company photographs pending
mission: To make convenient food products through coordinated work, responsible decision-making and attention to consistent production.
vision: To grow into a dependable manufacturing partner for the people and businesses we serve.

values.title: Responsibility
values.text: We take ownership of our work and communicate clearly.

values.title: Care
values.text: We pay attention to people, products and the details that matter.

values.title: Progress
values.text: We learn from daily work and improve our processes over time.

milestones.event: LM MANUFACTURING CO., LTD. begins developing its manufacturing operations in Kampong Speu.
